title: Descended effective models glue with cartesian open charts
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be a singleton fpqc covering of schemes [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Let $V\to X$ carry a transport descent datum $D$ [def-pd-descent-datum]. Let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be an open covering of $V$ [def-weil-open-immersion], with $I$ in the universe of the underlying scheme spaces. Suppose each $U_i\to X$ carries a datum $E_i$ whose inclusion into $V$ intertwines its transport with $D$. Fix schemes $W_i$ over $Y$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] and maps $q_i:U_i\to W_i$ such that the square with $U_i\to X$, $W_i\to Y$, and $p$ is cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product], and $q_i$ is invariant under every transport of $E_i$. Then there exist a scheme $W_0$ over $Y$, a morphism $q_0:V\to W_0$, and open immersions $j_i:W_i\to W_0$, jointly covering $W_0$, with $j_i$ over $Y$, such that the square with edges $q_i:U_i\to W_i$, $U_i\to V$, $j_i:W_i\to W_0$, and $q_0:V\to W_0$ is cartesian for each $i$.

source.place: Descent, Tag 0AP4, proof: descended overlap opens and scheme gluing; chart-square verification made explicit

proof.text: Assume explicit effective models W_i over Y and invariant cartesian projections q_i:U_i to W_i for a small index type. Transport compatibility of each inclusion identifies E_i with the restriction of D. Applying inverse transport proves reverse invariance. Consequently the inverse image of U_j in U_i is invariant under E_i.

The projection q_i is a base change of the fpqc cover p. Identify its double pullback with the two transports on U_i, using the effective pullback square. The invariance of U_i intersect U_j says its preimages under the two projections agree. Apply open-subscheme fpqc descent to obtain a unique open W_ij of W_i whose inverse image is U_i intersect U_j.

The identity of U_i intersect U_j intertwines the two restricted data. Under the effective pullback identifications it is a compatible base-change morphism between W_ij and W_ji. Fpqc descent of morphisms supplies a unique transition isomorphism; descend the inverse likewise. Injectivity gives the inverse, identity and triple cocycle laws. The descended preimages of the triple intersections agree by uniqueness of descended opens.

Apply scheme gluing to the descended overlap opens and transitions, obtaining W_0 and open chart embeddings j_i:W_i to W_0 which jointly cover W_0. The maps from W_i to Y agree on the overlaps by fpqc faithfulness, so glue to a structure map W_0 to Y. The maps j_i q_i agree on intersections of U_i and U_j: this is exactly the descended transition compatibility pulled back to X. Glue them to q_0:V to W_0.

For each i, prove the chart square (q_i, inclusion of U_i, j_i, q_0) cartesian. Cover its inverse-image corner by the inverse images of all the chart embeddings j_j. In the j-th piece the inverse image of j_i is the descended overlap W_ji, whose pullback is the intersection of U_j and U_i by construction. Thus these local pieces identify with the covering intersections of U_i and have the identical overlap transition maps. Glue the identifications and their inverses to obtain the required pullback identification. If the index set is empty, V is empty by the covering hypothesis; use the empty scheme W_0 over Y and its unique projection. No transport-invariance or global cartesian conclusion for q_0 is asserted here.

theorem exists_glued_effective_model_charts
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y}
    (hp : Presieve.singleton p ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage Y)
    {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum p V)
    {I : Type u} (U : I → V.left.Opens)
    (hcover : ∀ x : V.left, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (E : ∀ i, Over.DescentDatum p (Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
      (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)),
      ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ (U i).ι =
        (D.transport f₁ f₂ h (Over.homMk (a.left ≫ (U i).ι)
          (by simpa only [Over.mk_hom, Category.assoc] using Over.w a))).left)
    (W : I → Over Y) (q : ∀ i, (U i).toScheme ⟶ (W i).left)
    (hcart : ∀ i, IsPullback (q i) ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom) (W i).hom p)
    (hinv : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
      (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)),
      ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ q i = a.left ≫ q i) :
    ∃ (W₀ : Over Y) (q₀ : V.left ⟶ W₀.left) (j : ∀ i, (W i).left ⟶ W₀.left),
      (∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)) ∧
      (∀ w : W₀.left, ∃ i, ∃ z : (W i).left, j i z = w) ∧
      (∀ i, j i ≫ W₀.hom = (W i).hom) ∧
      (∀ i, IsPullback (q i) (U i).ι (j i) q₀)
